verdict.rationale: CrewAI AMP documents deploying crews to managed infrastructure "with a few clicks" and accessing deployed crews via REST API. Concrete endpoints are listed: POST /kickoff to start an execution, GET /status/{kickoff_id} to check it, and POST /resume for human feedback. Together these cover deploy-to-managed-runtime and call-as-an-API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the managed deployment, detailed docs on the deployment workflow (auth, scaling, CLI deploy path), and a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404s at the standard paths).
